verdict.rationale: Basecamp publishes a public REST API reference with an OpenAPI spec that covers authentication, pagination and every endpoint. It supports OAuth 2.0, includes 'Copy as cURL' examples, and documents rate-limit retry, conditional requests and file downloads. Official CLI and agent skills are also offered for AI-driven use. The probe 404 hit only a .md variant URL and does not contradict the API docs. Community comments are off-topic and were ignored. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving the API successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
OAuth 2.0 allows users to authorize your application to use Basecamp on their behalf without having to copy/paste API tokens or touch sensitive login information.
Throughout the Basecamp API docs, we include "Copy as cURL" examples.
